title: Merry Christmas!
html:
Almost done with another fruitful year, counting two major releases, the first edition of a dedicated conference for Kamailio and presence at over a dozen events world wide, it’s time to say thanks to everyone that helped along the time — developers, users, businesses investing resources and all the friends around the project!

A Merry Christmas and great winter holidays!
